text:
The Department of Agricultural Economics at National Taiwan University (NTU) invites applicants for three full-time faculty positions starting August 1, 2027.
The positions are open at the rank of Assistant Professor or Associate Professor. Qualified applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree by the date of appointment (postdoctoral experience is preferred). We welcome applications in the following specialized areas: (i) Natural Resource and Environmental Economics, (ii) Policies, Institutions, Development, Marketing, Trade, and Consumption, and (iii) Land, Resource, and Environment. Non-Chinese speakers are welcome to apply; English proficiency is required.

Application Documents:
1.Cover letter (please specify the position and specialized area(s); applicants may list multiple areas relevant to their research interests)
2.Curriculum Vitae (including publication list)
3.Official academic transcript(s) of the Ph.D. program (required if graduated after August 1, 2024; applicants whose programs do not have coursework requirements should provide an official letter of justification from their advisor or program)
4.Job market paper
•The job market paper must be published in an academic journal indexed in SCIE/SSCI within five years of the appointment date (after August 1, 2022). The applicant must be either the first author or corresponding author. If the paper is co-authored, verification of the co-author’s contribution to the applicant’s representative publication is required.
(https://webpageprodvm.ntu.edu.tw/personen/News_Content.aspx?Create=1&n=166731&state=F5D336F102ACBC68&s=206791&sms=101637)
•For applicants to the rank of Assistant Professor, the job market paper may be part of the doctoral dissertation, provided that the complete draft of the dissertation is submitted prior to the external review process.
5.Research statement
6.Teaching statement
7.Two recommendation letters

Application Instructions:
All application materials should be uploaded to the American Economic Association JOE Network by December 15, 2026.
https://www.aeaweb.org/joe/listing.php?JOE_ID=111478296
